rationale: Adds PopupWindow to the generic platform layer: a borderless, non-activating child window anchored to a rectangle in an editor view and placed on that view's screen, with a layer-backed content view a client draws into, dismissed by a consumed outside click, Escape, focus loss or the parent closing, and closed silently when its MainThreadScope dies. place_popup exposes the placement arithmetic. Additive and free of view or render dependencies, so the next Vellum re-export of core/platform should carry it.
